item.title: New chancellor named for University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences
item.description: C. Lowrey Barnes, M.D. has been named the new chancellor of the University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences, and will focus on creating a culture of exceptional hospitality and service for patients, families, and guests.

item.title: Crews responding after train derails in Russellville
item.description: Crews are responding to a train derailment in Russellville on Thursday.

item.title: Arkansas linemen help rebuild storm-ravaged power system in Mississippi
item.description: Hundreds of miles away from Arkansas utility workers are on the ground helping restore electricity after a devastating ice storm left thousands without power and caused widespread damage to infrastructure.

item.title: Raptor Rehab of Central Arkansas cares for hurt bald eagle
item.description: The Raptor Rehab of Central Arkansas, a non-profit that cares for sick, injured, or orphaned birds of prey, took in a hurt bald eagle in December and was slowly helping the animal regain her strength.

item.title: UA–Pulaski Tech announces plans to build multi-million dollar work force training center
item.description: Through a partnership with the Little Rock Port Authority and Little Rock Chamber of Commerce, the University of Arkansas Pulaski Technical College announced plans to build a $20 million workforce training center that's designed to serve as a pipeline for students to land high-paying jobs at the Port and other local businesses.

item.title: Second woman comes forward alleging rape, assault by former Conway surgeon
item.description: Former Conway surgeon Guy Peeples is facing additional charges of rape and sexual assault against a second patient, as well as charges of rape and sexual assault against a 70-year-old patient.
